title: Sample Table Read
description: Three-line smoke test for the Script Player.

turns.speaker: rubella
turns.text: Okay, cold open. Nobody panic. The script is the script.

turns.speaker: lillith
turns.text: But is a script read aloud still a script, or merely a rumor with timing?

turns.speaker: riley
turns.text: I measured it. Eighty percent rumor, twenty percent timing.
